_comment: THE REAL system-kind OPENING — the recording the pinned "כנסו לכאן" step exists for. The regress
harness ignores this key (fixtureSchema strips what it does not name).
PROVENANCE. Demo 29c5ed05-f1d4-4d10-a4d1-5c07f0506d82, analysis c5cb4d90 (analyze_demo@v3, 53
states, created 2026-09-20), the founder's own tavnit.ai recording, exported by a read-only SELECT
on 2026-09-23. The timeline is VERBATIM. It was scanned for emails, phone numbers and
greeting+name strings before it went in: zero hits, so nothing was replaced. What IS in it: the
Google new-tab page's trending searches on state 0 (not the founder's — Google's), the founder's
own questionnaire (product_name "test", every field "test" except the audience), and other tabs'
titles in the autocomplete list. demo.description was null.
WHY IT EXISTS. States 0-5 are the Chrome new tab and the address bar being typed ("tavnit.ai" is
in visibleText on 1, 2, 3 and 5; state 4 shows "tavnit.a"), and analyze_demo@v3 read every one of
them as screenKind "system" — an OS surface, which PLAN_SKIP_SCREEN_KINDS forbids to the model and
the picker hid under "פחות מתאימים" until decision 0064 (2026-09-28). The prompt's own "Open with the way in" rule could not be
honoured, and every plan the founder approved on this demo carried a HAND-ADDED step 1
"[0] כנסו לכאן". This fixture is that recording with the pin done by code.
THE PIN, DERIVED (findAccessMoment, code constants: step floor 3000ms):
window: states before the first product/loading state = 0..5 (6 is "loading").
candidates (type/select, not unreadable/dup, kind not login/onboarding/error/tour, a
visibleText entry with a domain token and no "@"): 1, 2, 3, 5. State 0 has no domain; state 4
has only "tavnit.a" (no TLD).
run: [1,2,3,5] — consecutive candidates 600/1000/1400ms apart, all within one step.
runEnd: the state after the run = state 6 at 5000ms.
pin: the LATEST run candidate whose 3000ms clip ends at or before 5000 — state 5 ends 7200,
3 ends 5800, 2 ends 4800 -> state 2 (1800ms). The clip runs 1800-4800 and the address bar
reads the completed "tavnit.ai" from state 5 (4200ms), inside the clip.
drop zone: [1200, max(5000, 4800)) = [1200, 5000) — the run plus the pin's clip.
expected.dryRunSourceIndexes = [2,9,14,24,29,44,49], DERIVED from dryRunPlan with the pin:
the canned planner gets min 4 / max 6 (5-1 / 7-1) and may not select 1-5 (pin + drop zone).
quality pool (legibility high, not dup, not idle, not a skip kind, outside the zone):
subsampleClusters(11 -> 6) keeps pool[floor(i*11/6)] = pool[0,1,3,5,7,9] and replaces the last
with the pool's last: [9,14,24,29,44,52].
ending: the last selectable result state is 49 (results: 26, 36, 44, 49). Keep only states
before it — 52 (88000ms) goes — subsample(5 -> 5) is the identity, append 49:
spacing walk (drop the earlier of any pair under 3000ms): every gap is >= 13000 -> unchanged.
prepend the pin: [2,9,14,24,29,44,49]. 7 steps = A_STEPS_MAX_DEFAULT exactly.
Asserted by the packages/core 'plan regress' test under DRY_RUN — load-bearing.
expected.sourceIndexes (LIVE) = [2,7,16,23,26,44,49] — DERIVED from the founder's approved plan
ca8d5b72 on this demo ([0,7,16,23,26,44,49]) with his hand-added [0] replaced by the rule's pin
[2]: state 7 (5600ms) sits outside the drop zone and 3800ms after the pin, so it survives. The
recording has genuine result states, so no allowNotes: a live run drifting from this set is DRIFT
to read, not a failure to fix. Re-pin only from a live plan the founder has reviewed.
2026-10-01 (decisions 0070/0072 — a step ends on a real screen change): recordingMs 89582 is
demos.duration_ms of 29c5ed05, read 2026-10-01. The pin moves 2 -> 1: the run [1, 2, 3, 5] sits
on the New Tab screen, which the code ends at 4400ms (one sample past state 5), and state 1
(1200ms) is the earliest candidate whose clip reaches that end inside the 4s cap — the pin now
shows the address typed through to the end, 3200ms. THE PIN, DERIVED above is superseded. The
live sourceIndexes take the new pin; dryRunSourceIndexes re-derived to [1, 14, 26, 29, 47, 49].
The live colour is unverified under plan_demo_steps@v15 until a paid regress — state 16 has
800ms to its screen's end and can no longer carry a caption.
